mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, memory_store_uuid, memory_store_external_id, current_version_uuid, COALESCE(current_version_external_id, '') AS current_version_external_id, path, content_size_bytes, content_sha256, s3_bucket, s3_key, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memories ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, memory_store_uuid, memory_store_external_id, current_version_external_id, path, content_size_bytes, content_sha256, s3_bucket, s3_key, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.MemoryStoreUUID}, #{params.MemoryStoreExternalID}, #{params.CurrentVersionExternalID}, #{params.Path}, #{params.ContentSizeBytes}, #{params.ContentSHA256}, #{params.S3Bucket}, #{params.S3Key}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE memories SET current_version_uuid = #{params.VersionUUID}, current_version_external_id = #{params.VersionExternalID}, path = #{params.Path}, content_size_bytes = #{params.ContentSizeBytes}, content_sha256 = #{params.ContentSHA256}, s3_bucket = #{params.S3Bucket}, s3_key = #{params.S3Key}, updated_at = #{params.UpdatedAt} WHERE workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND memory_store_external_id = #{params.MemoryStoreExternalID} AND external_id = #{params.MemoryExternalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING
